import java.util.*;
import java.math.BigInteger;

public class Main {
    static int L, K, P, n = 0, m;
    static long[] bit = new long[20], fac, ifac, bitcnt;
    static long[][] suma, sumc;
    static long[][] dp, tmp;
    static int[] bits;

    static long power(long a, int t) {
        long r = 1;
        while (t > 0) {
            if ((t & 1) == 1) r = r * a % P;
            a = a * a % P;
            t >>= 1;
        }
        return r;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        L = sc.nextInt();
        K = sc.nextInt();
        P = sc.nextInt();

        fac = new long[L + 1];
        ifac = new long[L + 1];
        bitcnt = new long[L + 1];
        // Calculate factorial and bitcnt
        fac[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= L; i++) {
            fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % P;
            bitcnt[i] = bitcnt[i >> 1] + (i & 1);
        }
        long all = power(K, L);
        if ((L & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(all);
            return;
        }
        // Compute inverse factorial
        ifac[L] = power(fac[L], P - 2);
        for (int i = L; i >= 1; i--) {
            ifac[i - 1] = ifac[i] * i % P;
        }

        // Build bit array
        List<Long> bitList = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; (1 << i) <= L; i++) {
            if (((L >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                bitList.add((long)(1 << i));
            }
        }
        bits = new int[bitList.size()];
        for (int i = 0; i < bitList.size(); i++) {
            bits[i] = bitList.get(i).intValue();
        }
        n = bits.length;
        m = 1 << n;

        suma = new long[(int)(L + 1)][m];
        sumc = new long[(int)(L + 1)][m];
        dp = new long[(int)(L + 1)][m];
        tmp = new long[(int)(L + 1)][m];

        // Build suma array
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int s = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (((i >> j) & 1) == 1) s += bits[j];
            }
            suma[bitcnt[i]][i] = ifac[s];
        }

        // Get sum over sum
        for (int t = 0; t <= n; t++) {
            for (int len = m; len >= 2; len >>= 1) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j += len) {
                    int half = len >> 1;
                    for (int k = 0; k < half; k++) {
                        suma[t][j + k + half] += suma[t][j + k];
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                suma[t][j] %= P;
            }
        }

        for (int t = 0; t <= n; t++) {
            System.arraycopy(suma[t], 0, dp[t], 0, m);
        }

        int cc = 0;
        int revK = 0;
        int tempK = K;
        while (tempK > 0) {
            revK = (revK << 1) | (tempK & 1);
            cc++;
            tempK >>= 1;
        }
        cc--;
        revK >>= 1;

        for (; cc > 0; cc--, revK >>= 1) {
            Arrays.fill(tmp, new long[m]);
            for (int a = 0; a <= n; a++) {
                for (int b = 0; b <= n - a; b++) {
                    long[] f = tmp[a + b];
                    long[] g = dp[a];
                    long[] h = dp[b];
                    for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                        f[j] += g[j] * h[j];
                        if (f[j] >= P) f[j] %= P;
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int t = 0; t <= n; t++) {
                System.arraycopy(tmp[t], 0, dp[t], 0, m);
            }

            if ((revK & 1) == 1) {
                Arrays.fill(tmp, new long[m]);
                for (int a = 0; a <= n; a++) {
                    for (int b = 0; b <= n - a; b++) {
                        long[] f = tmp[a + b];
                        long[] g = dp[a];
                        long[] h = suma[b];
                        for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                            f[j] += g[j] * h[j];
                            if (f[j] >= P) f[j] %= P;
                        }
                    }
                }
                for (int t = 0; t <= n; t++) {
                    System.arraycopy(tmp[t], 0, dp[t], 0, m);
                }
            }
        }

        // Get sumc
        for (int t = 0; t <= n; t++) {
            System.arraycopy(dp[t], 0, sumc[t], 0, m);
        }

        for (int t = 0; t <= n; t++) {
            for (int len = 2; len <= m; len <<= 1) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j += len) {
                    int half = len >> 1;
                    for (int k = 0; k < half; k++) {
                        sumc[t][j + k + half] -= sumc[t][j + k];
                        sumc[t][j + k + half] = (sumc[t][j + k + half] % P + P) % P;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        long ans = (all - sumc[n][m - 1] * fac[L] % P + P) % P;
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
